body:
### Info button nested in duration pressable

**Medium Severity**

The TWAP runtime info `ButtonIcon` is nested inside the duration `ButtonBase`. Tapping the info affordance can also fire `onDurationPress`, so the duration picker can open together with the runtime tooltip—or steal the tap entirely. The new info control never received `hitSlop`, so the inner target is also much smaller than the parent row.
action: Moved the info ButtonIcon out of the duration ButtonBase into an absolutely positioned sibling, added a 12pt hitSlop, and asserted in the unit test that pressing it does not call onDurationPress.

body: Flaky unit test detection: J9 module-level mutable `let mockInputHandlesActive` not reset in beforeEach (high); J10 jest.spyOn(Keyboard, 'dismiss') without jest.restoreAllMocks() in afterEach (medium); PerpsOrderTypeBottomSheet J3 shared mockTrack mock state (high) and J10 missing restoreAllMocks (medium).
action: Every suggested safeguard already exists at HEAD (beforeEach reset, afterEach restoreAllMocks, beforeEach clearAllMocks), with 0/489 failures over 30 days; replied with a consolidated issue comment.
